traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: calyx campanulate, 5-cleft; petals rounded, equal; stamens 20 to 24; carpels 1 to 5, mostly 3, somewhat united toward the base; ovary superior (tribe Spiraeeae). The Burke Herbarium (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read) gives about 30 stamens and 3 to 5 carpels for Pacific ninebark.

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Physocarpus chapter (read in full): ninebark flowers cluster in terminal corymbs.
